notes: Round 2 widened the lower-order coefficients of all three known patterns (337k fractions) and found 0 new identities: every hit was a shift or rescaling of a known one. Either these patterns are exhausted, or their other members have limits outside the Mobius table (|coef| <= 6). Round 3 tests the second explanation by re-running the two richest patterns with a table up to |coef| <= 12, plus a fresh region: a(n) = n + i with b2 = 0 (b linear), where convergence is fast and nothing has been searched yet.

families.name: r3 3n-type, Mobius <= 12
families.rationale: Same region as r2's 3n family, larger target table: are there members whose limits need bigger coefficients?

families.name: r3 linear b: a = a1 n + a0, b = b1 n + b0
families.rationale: b linear gives very fast convergence; unexplored so far. a1 1..6, wide constants.
